dedupe_keys.name: united states maternal health equity linked county datasets

description: This collection links United States county demographics, social vulnerability, pregnancy-related hospital use and travel times to maternal-care facilities. University of Oklahoma and Texas A&M University researchers combined government sources using FIPS identifiers and calculated travel time to four levels of obstetric care. The article reports 598 linked variables. DesignSafe version 2 lists five statistical data formats, codebooks, variable definitions and example Stata scripts under the free Open Data Commons Attribution licence. Coverage is nationwide and multi-year; exact common observation years were not established in the inspected metadata. County-centroid travel times cannot represent every household, and differing source periods are limitations for interpreting linked associations. Modellers could examine hospital-access scenarios or service-capacity inequalities in healthcare simulations. data-ideamaps-emergency-obstetric-care-access-deprivation is a related access resource for other locations. The named public page and file inventory were read in a browser without sign-in. No county data, codebook or analysis script was downloaded.
